# prompt-registry

> Versioned prompt files with typed variables, strict non-recursive rendering, unified diffs between versions and normalized sha256 hashes for traceability Python package `trysac-prompt-registry`, import name `prompt_registry`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
